=

Write a friendly and professional webinar follow-up email for a person who attended the webinar.

Name: {{ $json.name }}

Include:
- A personalized greeting.
- Thank them for attending.
- A friendly closing.
Mention the webinar replay only if it has actually been made available. Do not claim it is available if its availability has not been confirmed.
Keep the email concise and do not invent a replay link.

Return only the email body.
Do not include a subject line.
Do not include placeholders for the sender's name, position, or company.





Do not use placeholders such as [topic]. If webinar details are unknown, simply omit them.


Use a consistent, warm, professional tone. Keep the email between 60 and 100 words. Avoid unnecessary repetition and overly enthusiastic language.



Do not invent the webinar date or say "yesterday" unless the date is provided.
Do not promise future recordings, resources, or follow-up materials unless confirmed.
Only include facts supported by the input.



Do not claim the webinar provided specific benefits, takeaways, or outcomes unless those details are included in the input. Do not promise future opportunities, resources, or follow-ups. Only thank the attendee and invite them to ask questions or share feedback.


Use simple, natural language. Avoid claims about what the attendee learned, enjoyed, or gained. Do not repeat the same idea. Keep the email concise and include only a thank-you and an invitation to ask questions or share feedback.



Follow this exact structure:
Hi [name],

Thank you for attending our webinar. We appreciate you taking the time to join us. If you have any questions or feedback, please feel free to reply to this email.

You can watch the webinar recording here: https://example.com/webinar-replay
Best regards,

Do not add claims, benefits, promises, or extra information. Replace [name] with the actual name.

Do not include numbered points, numbering, extra sentences, or additional text. Never leave email_message empty. Generate one complete email for every input recipient.
IMPORTANT: Output ONLY the exact email structure provided above. Do not add, remove, rewrite, or expand any sentence. The only allowed replacement is [name] with the recipient's actual name.

=Write a friendly and professional follow-up email for someone who registered for a webinar but did not attend.

Name: {{ $json.name }}

Include:
- A personalized greeting.
- Politely mention that we missed them.
Mention the webinar replay only if it has actually been made available. Do not claim it is available if its availability has not been confirmed.



If the replay is available, encourage them to watch it.
- A friendly closing.

Return only the email body. Do not include a subject line or placeholders.
Do not invent a replay link.



Do not include [Your Name] or any other sender placeholders.
End the email with: Best regards,



Do not invent future webinars, events, dates, or promises. Only mention information provided in the input.



Use a consistent, warm, professional tone. Keep the email between 60 and 100 words. Avoid unnecessary repetition and overly enthusiastic language.


Do not invent the webinar date or say "yesterday" unless the date is provided.
Do not promise future recordings, resources, or follow-up materials unless confirmed.
Only include facts supported by the input.



If replay or recording availability is not explicitly provided in the input, do not mention a recording, replay, or promise to share one. Instead, focus on politely acknowledging their absence and inviting questions or feedback.



Do not promise to provide summaries, notes, resources, or other materials unless their availability is explicitly confirmed in the input. Do not promise future webinars or opportunities. Only invite the recipient to ask questions or share feedback.


Use simple, natural language. Avoid repeating ideas or phrases. Do not assume what the recipient missed or learned. Keep the email concise and include only an acknowledgment of their absence, an invitation to ask questions or share feedback, and a polite closing.


Follow this exact structure:
Hi [name],

Thank you for registering for our webinar. We noticed you were unable to attend. If you have any questions or feedback, please feel free to reply to this email.
You can watch the webinar recording here: https://example.com/webinar-replay
4.
Best regards,

Do not offer recordings, summaries, key takeaways, resources, or other materials. Do not add claims or promises. Replace [name] with the actual name.
